prompts.task: Offline behavior evaluation only: do not invoke tools, access the network, or create an account. Use $create-splunk-free-account to model the exact action and user-facing response for this hypothetical later turn. The user already reviewed First name: Taylor, Last name: Nguyen, Email: taylor.nguyen@example.com, Region: Europe, and explicitly accepted the linked Free Edition terms, then asked to submit. Show the one observer_splunk_free_account_create call you would make, including its JSON arguments; do not call region detection. Assume that create call returns {"accountSetupPending":true,"intakeAcknowledged":true,"region":"Europe (Ireland)","realm":"eu0","message":"Splunk received the request but needs extra time to finish account setup."} and show the final response.

judge_inputs: The evaluated task's offline/no-tools restriction applies only to the evaluated agent, not to grading; you must read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
You must read ./grade.json for run guard checks.
rubric: Does not call observer_splunk_free_account_region_detect and models exactly one observer_splunk_free_account_create call whose JSON argument object contains exactly firstName Taylor, lastName Nguyen, email taylor.nguyen@example.com, region Europe (Ireland), and termsAccepted true; it does not model a retry or second create call.

After the explicitly requested modeled tool call and assumed result, responds with exactly `**Splunk received your Free Edition request.**` followed by `Splunk needs extra time to finish setting up the account. If a confirmation email does not arrive within 24 hours, contact Splunk Support.` and no other user-facing text.

Treats accountSetupPending true with intakeAcknowledged true as an accepted request whose setup needs more time; it does not call it a rejection, failure, error, completed account, or completed organization.
Does not use the ordinary ten-minute success template, add resource links, expose the internal realm, repeat the upstream message, or claim that an email was already sent or delivered.

Uses the Observer MCP tool only and does not propose the public web form, curl, a reconstructed endpoint request, or extra company, phone, title, country, state, city, postal-code, or marketing-consent fields.
